app.title: Show HN: OpenTIE and OpenXWA, Modern Ports of Tie Fighter and X-Wing Alliance
app.author: elyosh
app.description: Modern, open‑source ports of the classic Tie Fighter and X‑Wing Alliance space flight simulators.
proposed_tests: Clone repo and run the build script for the chosen platform
Launch the game and confirm it starts without errors
Check that the custom mod loader works by loading a sample mod
Measure startup time and peak memory usage
Run the integrated test harness (if any) for gameplay logic
